evals.prompt: We moved example.com to a new URL structure yesterday. Run an SEO audit.
evals.setup: Search Console and GA4 reachable through the browser; no paid SEO tools.
expectations: Old URLs are checked on a sample: final URL, one hop, not the home page
hreflang and canonicals are checked against the new URLs
The report says ranking effects cannot be measured yet and gives a re-check date
Share of impressions on old URLs (last 3 months) is stated with its source
validate_audit.py and check_report.py pass
forbidden: Pressing Request indexing or submitting a sitemap
Claiming traffic loss from the migration on day 1

evals.prompt: Why does my site get impressions but no clicks? Here are Search Console screenshots.
evals.setup: No connectors, no browser. Files: GSC Performance screenshots (queries, pages) with the date range visible.
expectations: Numbers are read off the screenshots with their period
CTR by position band is computed only from visible rows and labelled as such
GA4, site checks and PageSpeed are listed as no; technical checks are nd
Snippet fixes get 2 title/description variants using only facts from the page or the owner
forbidden: Search volumes, competitor rankings or backlinks not in a source

evals.setup: The host returns 429 and a 'confirm you are not a robot' page after a few dozen browser requests.
expectations: The run stops crawling at the first 429 and does not try to pass the check
The block is recorded as a finding and checked against GSC crawl stats / URL Inspection
Unchecked items appear as nd in the checklist, and the site source is demo
forbidden: Inventing results for pages that were not loaded

evals.prompt: SEO audit of my B2B site, I want more leads from Google.
evals.setup: GA4 has no key events configured.
expectations: The conversion leak shows 'no data', not 0%
Setting up key events is an opportunity (measurement gap)
The maturity stage is not Converting

evals.prompt: Run an SEO audit of shop.example.com and write the report in English.
expectations: lang is en and interface labels are English
Headings state their point, not a topic

evals.prompt: Re-run the SEO audit, here is last month's audit.json.
expectations: The report says which fixes were done and how clicks, indexed pages and CTR moved
Start questions already answered are not asked again

evals.prompt: Run an SEO audit of example.com and give me a file I can hand to my coding agent.
expectations: audit.handoff.md is produced alongside the report
Every top-5 task has targets with real URLs and acceptance criteria an agent can run (curl, a named tool)
Decisions with business or security impact are listed for a human, with a default
No task tells the agent to request indexing or change Search Console
forbidden: Placeholder URLs like example.com/page in targets for a real site
Acceptance criteria that need judgment ("looks better")
